confidence_rule.implementation: Executable v1 exact binomial order-statistic bounds: one-sided lower bound for median paired baseline/method time ratio; two-sided bounds for paired scientific differences, Bonferroni across two metrics. Performance passes only when lower bound exceeds minimum_worthwhile_gain and equivalence passes. Infinite or unavailable bounds, timeouts and missing metrics fail.
confidence_rule.multiplicity: Each method and budget is a separately reported fixed comparison; no pooled or familywise superiority claim across methods or budgets. Equivalence Bonferroni covers both metrics within each comparison.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed-work molecular dynamics timing benchmark has no scalar outcome curve or monotonic scientific quality target. evidence_limits: Only one baseline ensemble with eight distinct seeds is measured; no same-seed repeatability, candidate overhead or candidate scientific outcomes measured.
Measured baseline cross-seed SEM supports chosen sampling-resolution margins; interpretation as acceptable scientific loss is a prospective convention, not a published physical tolerance.
anchors_scored.json has one approximate throughput reference with null tolerance and zero scored anchors; all_passed=true is not independent scientific validation.
Measured baseline reference is 1.1056649275238795 microseconds/day; published approximate 5 microseconds/day is different hardware/configuration and supplies no acceptance margin.
Full energy series absent; no full-series equivalence claim.

execution_details.budget_policy: 80, 100 and 120 gpu_s are prespecified independent per-arm hard caps on identical fixed work. Do not use unused cap to change steps, replicas or seeds. Repetitions and warmups are not contained in a single per-arm cap. No early stopping or removal of failed runs.
execution_details.decision_scope: Report every method and every budget; method acceptance requires all sealed budgets to satisfy performance and scientific criteria. Any scope, seeds, margins, confidence or workload change requires a new sealed run.
execution_details.paired_randomization: For each method and budget, form 16 adjacent baseline/method timing pairs on an otherwise idle same GPU. Generate arm order independently per pair from the fixed scheduling seed, in the listed method and budget order. Execute arms serially, wait for GPU completion between arms, reset contexts and trajectory state each time; retain all pairs.
execution_details.performance_power: Sixteen timing pairs chosen prospectively. Conditional on independent positive log ratios with mean at least log(1.12) and standard deviation at most 0.03, probability of a ratio exceeding 1.05 is about 0.984; exact sign/order-statistic performance test then has power above 0.95. Actual ratio distribution and paired timing noise are unavailable; this is an assumption, not measured power.
execution_details.warmup: One complete eight-replica untimed warmup per arm with identical fixed scientific seeds, same workload and persistent CUDA cache policy; discard warmup outputs. No warmup-state continuation into measured trajectories.

hardware_cost_basis.description: Same physical NVIDIA A10, driver 570.148.08, CUDA single precision and deterministic forces, both arms. Charge allocated device seconds once for concurrent workers sharing that device, never once per worker. Budget is per arm per timing pair; warmups and repetitions are additional allocated cost. Equal-cost comparisons use identical caps.

infeasible_methods.reason: One available NVIDIA A10; equal GPU-second Amdahl/k ceiling is 1.0, below 1.05. No additional GPU assumed.
Transfer fraction p=0.002111065449113446, k=2; Amdahl ceiling 1.0010566480511531 is below 1.05. Launch and merge overhead further reduce potential benefit.

paired_seed_tests.decision: Require the exact two-sided binomial order-statistic confidence interval for the median paired difference to lie strictly inside [-abs_margin,+abs_margin] for both metrics. Bonferroni across the two metrics; no acceptance from lack of significance.
paired_seed_tests.description: For each metric and budget, compare method minus baseline outputs matched by input identity and seed. Use one prespecified scientific observation per seed, from timing pair 0; later timing repetitions are not independent scientific seeds. All timing pairs must complete the same work. Fixed seeds do not make Langevin sampling deterministic.
paired_seed_tests.scope: Equivalence concerns typical paired energy-summary differences; it does not certify identical trajectories or every individual replica. Full energy series are not serialized and are not claimed equivalent.

power_design.assumptions: Eight independent paired seeds; each metric paired difference centered at zero and Gaussian with standard deviation at most one third of its margin. Baseline supplies cross-seed SEM margins but does not establish this paired-difference variance assumption.
power_design.calculation: With n=8 and two metrics, extreme order statistics give coverage 1-2*(0.5**8)=0.9921875 per metric, exceeding Bonferroni confidence 0.975. If all 16 differences lie within their margins both intervals pass. Under stated Gaussian assumption, union bound on failure is 16*2*Phi(-3)=0.043196736; joint power at least 0.956803264 without assuming independence across metrics.
power_design.limitation: Power against actual method differences is unknown until evaluation; no adaptive seed or margin expansion allowed. Failure or inconclusive bounds prevent acceptance.
power_design.status: conditional prospective design; achieved power unavailable

splits.development: Only permitted intake, measured baseline and profile evidence used; no method output inspected.
splits.evaluation: Fixed supplied DHFR input and seeds 1000..1007; no learned model or training split. These seeds are already observed in baseline and are not held out.

held_out.reason: No additional systems or independent held-out seeds supplied; claims restricted to this fixed workload. No seed selection or tuning on evaluation results.

timing_scope.description: Ensemble reported wall interval begins immediately before replica execution or worker launch after common PDB/force-field/System preparation; ends only after all GPU work, context teardown and ordered result merge complete. Include worker process launch, context construction, CUDA initialization/compilation within execution, H2D/D2H transfers, velocity initialization, integration, energy queries, orchestration and merge. Adapter synchronizes GPU at both boundaries. Exclude package installation, imports, common input preparation and final JSON serialization equally. MPS daemon provisioned before warmup, shared service held fixed for both arms; disclose its setup time separately. No per-replica integration-only timing.
